title: EVALUATE of a table name returns its rows and all its columns, named Table[Column], in model order

source.quote: Returns all rows and columns from the Internet Sales table, as a table.
source.supports: a table name returns the whole table

source.quote: Tables in the model when referenced by name work with EVALUATE to output a result table showing the data in the table.
source.supports: a table name is a table expression

derivation: Customer has three columns and four rows, returned as they are and sorted by the key.
notes: The pages do not state the order of the columns; the order of the model definition is assumed.
